requirements.text: Validate CLI arguments: exit code 1 with stderr message if argument count is not two; exit code 2 with stderr message if invalid number, outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right.

requirements.text: Correct results counting even numbers in inclusive interval [left, right], including zero and negative values.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |

criteria.title: Build
criteria.verification_method: Execute CMake configure and build commands (`cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build`) and verify successful creation of the `count_even` executable.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values
criteria.verification_method: Run test cases covering positive/negative bounds, inclusion of endpoints, and ranges containing 0 (e.g. `1 5` -> 2, `-3 3` -> 3, `0 0` -> 1).

criteria.title: CLI validation
criteria.description: Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments
criteria.verification_method: Verify exit code 1 with stderr output when arg count != 2, and exit code 2 with stderr output when numbers are invalid, outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right.

criteria.title: Output format
criteria.description: Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors
criteria.verification_method: Verify stdout contains only the integer count followed by '\n' on success, and stdout is completely empty on error conditions.
